description: Create symmetric 5×5 pixel identicons hashed from any text — same text always gives the same icon. Download as PNG.

faqs.a: Your text is hashed (FNV-1a); the hash picks the color and fills a 5×5 grid mirrored left-to-right for symmetry.
Yes — identical text always produces the identical identicon.
The icon renders on canvas and downloads as a crisp PNG.
Type anything — a name, email, or username — and press Generate.

title: Identicon Generator
